rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Working Committee resolution headed 'CWC Resolution – 25, May 2019' records that 'Congress President, Shri Rahul Gandhi in his address to the CWC offered his resignation, as the party president.'

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The same resolution states: 'The CWC unanimously and with one voice rejected the same and requested the Congress President for his leadership and guidance in these challenging times.'

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The resolution of 25 May 2019 names 'Congress President, Shri Rahul Gandhi' and records that 'The CWC unanimously called upon the Congress President, Shri Rahul Gandhi to lead the party in its ideological battle'.
